values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754131 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754131 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 28ft.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists campsites, a toilet, drinking water and a hand launch; moderate accessibility.

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754131 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

note: MT FWP Fishing Access Site on the Bitterroot River, 6.5 mi S of Lolo on Hwy 93 then 1 mi E on Chief Looking Glass Rd. Back-in and pull-through sites plus tent sites; water 5/1-9/30; hand boat launch. --Claude
summary: FWP's FAS page confirms $12/$18 camping (with/without fishing license), 28-ft trailer limit, 7-day stay limit, drinking water, and the May 1 - Nov 30 season (already manual). Not stated on FWP's current page: site count (25), pull-throughs, how sites are taken (derived FCFS), water dates, toilet type; left as they were. Note trimmed of the length, stay-limit and FCFS restatements.
flags: Missing phone: FWP Region 2 (Missoula) is the contact for this FAS; aggregators give (406) 542-5500, which matches FWP Region 2's number used on other Region 2 FAS pages (e.g. Big Pine FAS).
Unconfirmed values: the 25-site count and pull-throughs in the inclusion evidence are attributed to the FWP page, but the current FWP page lists neither (Campendium gives 25 sites); left as is.
